content:
Apple today announced that it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13) with the tagline "Welcome home".

Apple 將於 10 月 13 日推出全新 Home 系列產品，由 Greg Joswiak 率先預告

Apple will launch several new products next Tuesday (October 13), teased in a short video posted by Greg Joswiak, Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing. Below is the video released by Joswiak:

預料 Apple 將於活動上推出多款全新 Home 系列產品，包括：

此外，外界亦預期早前流傳、由 Apple 與 LG 共同開發嘅智能家居配件，將會喺下星期同步亮相。

Alongside Joswiak's date announcement, Apple has already sent invitations to the media for the "Apple Experience" special event, to be held at Tribeca, New York, starting at 9 a.m. local time.

Below is the invitation shared by Marques Brownlee:

JP 嘅留言獲最多讚

Three products. I'm guessing it's the Apple Car, in space gray, white, and another slightly different shade of white.

Apple 較早前推出 MacBook Neo 嘅時候，亦曾為傳媒舉辦類似嘅「Apple Experience」活動。嗰次發佈之前，Apple 已經透過新聞稿形式連續多日公佈新產品。

However, current expectations are that all of Apple's new Home lineup this time will debut on the same day.

It remains unknown whether Apple will simultaneously upload a full product introduction video at 9 a.m. local time. We'll continue to follow the latest updates for you.

你最期待喺 10 月 13 日見到 Apple 推出邊啲新產品？欢迎喺留言區分享你嘅想法。

  • 十年續航 AirTag 保護殼
  • 100W USB-C 快速充電火牛
  • HomeKit 智能車庫門開關器
